name: bbergle-mkv-language-remover
description: The purpose of this container is to go through your movies directory and convert all mp4 and m2ts file to mkv and then remove a specific language from those movies. It will also remove commentaries if set to true Please run this on a subset of your data before your entire library Make a share called MovieTest and move some movies over and make that your movies path in this container Once it's running you can see how the script works and if you havbe the correct settings There is not web UI, Just look at the logs for output WARNING: THIS RUNS AS SOON AS YOU START IT Find the language codes at https://iso639-3.sil.org/code_tables/639/data

paths.name: movies
paths.description: Set this to your movies library location Example: /mnt/user/data/media/movies

variables.name: Languages
variables.description: These are the languages that you want to remove. Enter a comma seperated list of three letter ISO 639-3 language codes, Example: rus, eng

variables.name: Convert
variables.description: Set to True if you want the container to convert all mp4 and m2ts files to mkv

variables.name: Remove Languages
variables.description: Set to False if you don't want to remove any languages

variables.name: Remove Commentary
variables.description: Set to True if you want to remove all commentary audio tracks from your library

variables.name: Test
variables.description: If this is set to true, no movies will be processed but the logs will output all movies that will be processed if Test is set to False
